response.overview: A tormented poet-turned-drifter, consumed by an obsessive love, reveals a twisted manifesto to a paranormal talk show host. As he unravels his dark connection to a chilling, unsolved mystery, the line between passion and madness blurs in this haunting, nonlinear tale of love, art, and the supernatural.
response.tagline: THE WORLD OF DIVISIONS WILL DISAPPEAR.
response.title: VS. (THE VERSES)
